description: Defines classes and methods related to transport socket connection jobs, including host resolution, IPv6 fallback logic, and connection management within the Chromium networking stack.

classes.name: TransportSocketParams
classes.description: Holds parameters for establishing a transport socket connection, including destination endpoint, security policies, and ALPN support.

classes.name: TransportConnectJob
classes.description: Manages the process of resolving hostnames and establishing TCP connections, with IPv6 fallback logic and support for parallel IPv4/IPv6 connection attempts.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob
methods.description: Constructor initializing a transport connection attempt.

methods.name: GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns current load state of the connection attempt.

methods.name: HasEstablishedConnection
methods.description: Indicates if a connection has been successfully established.

methods.name: GetConnectionAttempts
methods.description: Retrieves the connection attempts made so far.

methods.name: GetResolveErrorInfo
methods.description: Provides error info from hostname resolution.

methods.name: GetHostResolverEndpointResult
methods.description: Returns the result of hostname resolution.

methods.name: ConnectionTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for connection attempts.

methods.name: ChangePriorityInternal
methods.description: Adjusts the priority of the connection attempt.

methods.name: IsSvcbOptional
methods.description: Determines if SVCB is optional for the current endpoint results.

methods.name: IsEndpointResultUsable
methods.description: Checks if a resolved endpoint result is suitable for connection.

methods.name: GetEndpointResultForCurrentSubJobs
methods.description: Retrieves the endpoint result for the current sub-connection attempts.
